boundary: Operational negatives remain retained after bounded recovery.

rows.observed: A read-only probe assumed inherited skill packages were repository-local, but the directory was absent.
rows.recovery: Resolve the committed skill-build receipt and sanitized package inventory before any location inference.

rows.observed: Nineteen smoke uses passed; the workload-boundary smoke assumed absent rotation-guard field names.
rows.recovery: Bind the smoke test to the frozen threshold and inherited-baseline fields and preserve first-invocation origin truth.

rows.observed: Nineteen smoke uses passed; the Method Flow preflight rejected a correctly retained active candidate.
rows.recovery: Permit a candidate only when its failed witness is retained, then require a passing witness before promotion.

rows.observed: The validator read the identity receipt through a nonexistent generic boundary field instead of its declared identity_boundary field.
rows.recovery: Bind the validator to the frozen identity-receipt schema and rerun the unchanged boundary assertion.

rows.observed: The source-status guard assumed per-row checked_date, evidence_use, and source_kind fields instead of the frozen ledger's checked_on, use, authority, and nullable local URL fields.
rows.recovery: Bind the runner to the frozen source-ledger schema and retain the stopped one-of-ten aggregate attempt.

rows.observed: A compound status, head, and large-file read wrapper exceeded its bounded timeout before returning evidence.
rows.recovery: Split the wrapper into independently bounded Git and file probes, retain the timed-out attempt, and credit only the successful probes.

rows.observed: The proposal-neighbor guard assumed a proposal_count key instead of the frozen index's frozen_chain_count_after_x1 key.
rows.recovery: Bind the guard to the frozen proposal-index schema and retain the stopped two-runner attempt with zero aggregate completion credit.

rows.observed: A diagnostic read assumed a nonexistent audit subdirectory after the runner had already identified the repository-relative provenance files.
rows.recovery: Read only the exact paths named by the runner implementation and give the failed path assumption no evidence credit.

rows.observed: After correcting the after-x1 count, the guard still assumed prior_proposal_count instead of prior_frozen_proposal_count in the collision audit.
rows.recovery: Bind the prior count to the collision-audit schema and require a fresh isolated pass before aggregate retry.

rows.observed: A read-only inspection assumed an x1_staged_review filename that was not present; the actual phase reviewer used the x1_review name.
rows.recovery: Discover reviewer names repository-relatively before selecting the exact existing source file.

rows.observed: Six tests passed and three errored because the test module assumed three artifact paths or fields that differed from the generated evidence schema.
rows.recovery: Discover exact generated paths and fields, synchronize the test module, and require a complete fresh replay.

rows.observed: The 202-file review parsed 178 JSON blobs but confirmed three private local scratch-path hits in staged runner sources.
rows.recovery: Replace owner-bank paths with a generic D-first scratch root, preserve fixture detection, and require a fresh zero-hit exact staged replay.

rows.observed: The evidence builder refused to run because the Git index contained the in-progress exact evidence surface.
rows.recovery: Unstage only the verified owner-scoped surface without changing worktree bytes, rebuild with an empty index, then restage exact paths.

rows.observed: The aggregate stopped at Method Flow preflight because the current staged-review recovery method correctly remained a candidate after its failed witness.
rows.recovery: Do not request terminal Method Flow aggregate credit while a recovery candidate is active; validate the candidate first, then replay the aggregate.
